_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Sympathetic Detonation Test Data
summary: Specifies the test and inspection conditions and results of the sympathetic detonation test, used to evaluate the response of test items subjected to proximate detonation of a like item.
description_purpose: This data comprises the test and inspection conditions and results of the sympathetic detonation test. It is used to evaluate the response of test item(s) subjected to proximate detonation of a like item.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for data generated by the sympathetic detonation test of MIL-STD-2105.

The following DID is used in conjunction with this DID and applies only if listed on the DD Form 1423 incorporated into the contract:
DI-SAFT-81126  Photographic Requirements
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The sympathetic detonation test data shall be formatted in accordance with figures 1, 2 and 3.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The sympathetic detonation test data shall include the information of figures 1, 2 and 3 and the following:

children.title: A dimensioned sketch depicting the pre-initiation donor
children.content: A dimensioned sketch depicting the pre-initiation donor and acceptor relative locations.

children.title: Location and identification of the post-test
children.content: Location and identification of the post-test remains depicted onto figure 2.

children.title: Description, location (linear and angular distance from original test position)
children.content: dimensions and weight of the post-test remains tabulated onto figure 3.
